text: __NOTOC__ Teromoths are moths found in the south of Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
Teng Firebrew is a patron of Halfhill's The Lazy Turnip tavern, in the Valley of the Four Winds. He is drinking alongside Kora Kang.
__NOTOC__ Teracula is an unbound earth elemental, imprisoned at Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Teng Applebloom is a pandaren quest giver and alcohol vendor located in the Jade Forest. Initially, he appears in Paw'don Village; after Priorities! (Alliance) is completed, he stands beside his wife in Paw'don Glade.
Terracotta Fragment has a chance to drop from the pandarian champion Jonn-Dar in the Valley of the Four Winds. Using it summons the Terracotta Warrior guardian.
Temple of Kotmogu Victory is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning a Temple of Kotmogu battle.
Temple of Kotmogu Veteran is a player vs. player achievement earned for completing 100 victories in Temple of Kotmogu.
Terrace of Endless Spring Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating all bosses in the Terrace of Endless Spring raid instance while in a guild group.
Tender Long is a pandaren located in Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.
Temple of the Jade Serpent Challenger is an achievement earned for completing the Temple of the Jade Serpent challenge mode.
Temple of the Jade Serpent: Silver is an achievement earned for completing the Temple of the Jade Serpent challenge mode with a rating of silver or better.
Temple of the Jade Serpent: Gold is an achievement earned for completing the Temple of the Jade Serpent challenge mode with a rating of gold.
Temple of the Jade Serpent: Bronze is an achievement earned for completing the Temple of the Jade Serpent challenge mode with a rating of bronze or better.

__NOTOC__ Terga Earthbreaker is an orc shaman trainer located in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Tatepi and Sagorne Creststrider. A version of Terga appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar. Terga was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Teromak is a level 36 rare wasp that can be found northwest of Direhorn Post in Dustwallow Marsh.
Tengfei Edgewater is a pandaren located in the Krasarang Wilds.
Teroclaw Nests are found throughout Talador, generally surrounded by Teroclaw Chick. Loot one to acquire a Teroclaw Hatchling and 10-20 Garrison Resources.
The Terokkar Wayshrine is a small waystation on the road between and Veil Terokk. According to Reshad, established many of these wayshrines all along the road to Skettis.

__NOTOC__ Temporal Crystals are created using 10 Fractured Temporal Crystal. This item can be found in Faintly-Sparkling Cache. This item is crafted with enchanting by using 1 Luminous Shard. This item can be found when disenchanting level 96+ items, as well as crafted level 91 epic items. Epic quest items from the upgraded item system does not count but disenchants to Sha Crystal instead.

Ten Hit Tunes is an achievement awarded for learning ten music rolls for the Garrison Jukebox. See the music rolls section of the Garrison Jukebox article for a summary of the sources, and each individual roll has more information.
Terokkar Lilac was sold by Griftah just outside Shattrath's southeastern tunnel in Terokkar Forest.
Tenumi is a draenei located at the Pilgrim's Road‎ in Talador.
The Tentacled Hat drops from the Lunarfall Cavedweller and the Frostdeep Cavedweller.
Temple of Orsis is a temple located in Uldum, presumably in Orsis. It serves as the first wing of the League of Explorers adventure in Hearthstone.
__NOTOC__ Teroclaw Hatchling can be looted from Teroclaw Nests in Talador. It can only be looted once.
Tender Daranelle is a dryad located at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
Terestian's Signet Ring drops from The Curator in the Return to Karazhan.
Terms of Engagement was a Survival hunter artifact trait that caused killing an enemy to reset Harpoon's cooldown. It was linked to the Raptor's Cry and My Beloved Monster traits.
Terra'gul is a sand elemental located south of Telaar, at the edge of Nagrand.
Terrace Grove-Tenders are nightborne located inside the Nighthold and its instance.
__NOTOC__ Tereck the Selector is a rare elite eredar located in a cave in the Petrified Forest in Krokuun. He was capturing Krokul Wranglers.
Terokkar Talon Guards are arakkoa located in of Spires of Arak.

Terminus is a massive port for Legion ships in the Antoran Wastes. A massive portal spire looms over the area that which may start summoning the Paraxis initiating an event for the entire zone. It is protected with the artillery at Felfire Armory. The vessels docked at Terminus were taking on soldiers and supplies for the Legion's assaults against Azeroth. Champions of Class Orders were sent to bring the vessels down.
The Temple of Sethraliss is a dungeon in Battle for Azeroth. The entrance is located at Skycallers' Spire in northern Vol'dun.
Temptress Salacia was a sayaad located in Broken Shore. She was engaged in a battle with the Conclave and was taken down when the Knights of the Silver Hand joined the fray.
Teran Sideskorn was a vrykul buried at the Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim. His spirit would rise again and attack the Order of the Broken Temple until he was put to rest by them.
Terokk's Terror is a submarine located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Terrace of the Tiger is located at the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.
Temptations are mandragoras located in the Forge of Aeons. They will occasionally spawn Alluring Flowers.
Teron'gor's Whisper was a submarine of the Iron Horde. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
__NOTOC__ Teres is a siren located at the Wanderer's Cove in Tiragarde Sound.
__NOTOC__ Tentulos the Drifter is a helsquid located north of Old Drust Road in Tiragarde Sound.
Teri Lockfield is a gnome located in the Harbor Barber in Boralus. He had moved to the barbershop after the original barber mysteriously vanished.
Tenra Softwind is a pandaren located at Paw'don Bean Dumplings in Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Tendrils of Gore are tentacles located in Ruin's Descent in Uldir.
Tendrils of Revival is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Mists of the Broken Temple and Effusive Mists traits.

__NOTOC__ The Terrace of the Fang makes up the lower ruins of the Temple of Kimbul on the northeastern coast of Vol'dun. It is overrun with giant jungle spiders. A small building on the northern part of the terrace houses three Tablets of Kimbul's teachings and a Statue of Eraka No Kimbul hiding the :Ring of Tides.
The Tender Hjarta Loop is a quest reward from Bjornharta (quest).
The Terrace of Torcali is located in the Terrace of the Chosen in Dazar'alor.
The Terrace of Crafters is located in northwestern base of Dazar'alor. It is here where all the profession trainers can be found and the Shred-Master Mk1 as well next to Myxle "The Searat" Gutwrench.
The Terrace of the Chosen is located at the base of Zanchul in northern Dazar'alor in Zuldazar. Shrines and worshippers of many loa are gathered all along the terrace.
Terrace Fountains are broken fountains located at the northern and southern ends of the Withering Gulch in Vol'dun.
Tensile Eye Stalks drop from crabs in Darkshore, Kul Tiras, Nazjatar and Zandalar.
Tentacle-Laced Spaulders drops from Vol'zith the Whisperer in the Shrine of the Storm.

The Tendril of Corruption is a section of the massive body of N'Zoth resembling a giant sea monster similar to Iso'rath. Uu'nat is fought in its eye-filled bowels. The Shrine of Shadows is eaten by a maw of the Tendril of Corruption opening the way inside the Tendril of Corruption.

__NOTOC__ The Terrace of the Devoted (or the Temple Grounds) is a multileveled terrace that surrounds the Sanctuary of the Devoted on the western coast of Vol'dun. It is currently engulfed in battle between the Devoted and an army of Faithless invaders. The terrace is surrounded by a shallow moat spanned by two bridges, one stretching northeast and the other southeast. The Forgotten Marsh lies to the north, the Forward Camp to the northeast, Dead Man's Pass due east, and the Cracked Coast to the south.
Tentacles of Shul-Nagruth are tentacles that spawn during the fight with the Maw of Shul-Nagruth in Nazmir.
Tentacled Voidpriests are k'thir located in the Crucible of Storms.
Tenacious Garnriders are Mag'har orcs located in Stormsong Valley during Faction Assaults. They are raiders riding garn.
Tempting Sirens are sirens located in the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Tenebrous Gateway is located in the Chamber of Heart. This gateway is used to enter the Vision of Stormwind and the Vision of Orgrimmar. The gate is also used to escape the visions.

__NOTOC__ The Terrace of Sorrows is a set of ruins in western Nazmir. It used to be a temple to Bwonsamdi, but the terrace is under the control of the blood trolls, who serve G'huun. There are troll zombies here controlled by Kel'vax.
Teng the Awakened is a mogu ghost located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Tempula is a Forsworn kyrian located at the Temple of Humility in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ The Temple of the Prophet is located in Zuldazar. It was Zul's personal abode, and he wrote some of his prophecies there.
Temporal Blossoming can be looted from Relinquished Arcane Relic.
__NOTOC__ Tempomancer Virinya is a nightborne located in Suramar. Feeding her Ancient Mana provides a buff increasing Haste while in the Broken Isles for 15 minutes.
Teregeer Crystals are sold by Acquirer Ta'gosh in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos for .
__NOTOC__ Tenaval is a venthyr located in Sinfall in Revendreth.

The Temple of Purity is one of Bastion's major holy sites that represent one of the virtues of the kyrian Ascended, located in the southeast of the region. The temple is an important spot for aspirants on their path to ascension as they work to rid themselves of any doubts they carry, thus becoming pure according to the kyrian path. The area is overseen by the Paragon of Purity, Vesiphone, and her followers. It is the base of the Watchers.
The Temporal Leaves are provided as an objective for Catalyze This.
Tenebrous Truffles are looted from Sprouting Growths in Maldraxxus. They are also sold by Melody Madcap.
Temptessa's Knee-High Boots drop from Lady Temptessa at Socrethar's Rise in .
Ten Tickles: A Cautionary Tale is a tome located in Sagehold in Stormsong Valley.
The Teroclaw Hen-Mother is a teroclaw located just west of in Talador. She maintains several Teroclaw Nests while caring for the Teroclaw Chicks.

Teramanik's Gilded Reins are looted from Greed's Desire in Revendreth. The item comes with a curse; , preventing the player from mounting. The curse can be removed by normal means, or by Cursebreaker Arnon at the Absolution Crypt.

The Temple of Devotion, formerly called the Temple of Loyalty and Citadel of Loyalty, is located in northwestern Bastion. It was formerly under the rule of Paragon Devos and her Hand Lysonia, but Polemarch Adrestes was made into the new Paragon of Devotion, with his Hand Kleia. Pelagos, Nikolon, and Uther plan to join this temple.
Terrace of the Collectors is located in northern Bastion. It is populated by Wisdom affiliated kyrian aspirants and ascended, named after the Collectors. It leads into the Court of Elation.
The Terrace of Inner Grace is located in eastern Bastion and part of the Temple of Humility.
Tenebrous Crown Roast Aspic is created with Shadowlands Cooking (60); taught by Chef Au'krut.
Terminus Signaling Beacon drops from the Antoran High Command in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Tender Turtle Meat would drop from Speckled Sea Turtles in Kelp'thar Forest.
Teroclaw Chicks are teroclaws located throughout Talador. They are often found near Teroclaw Nests.
Tenderized Breastplate drops from Thrashbite the Scornful in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Teroclaw Bindings are a world drop and are looted from Rusted Lockbox.
Teroclaw Boots are a world drop and are looted from Rusted Lockbox.
Teroclaw Britches are a world drop and are looted from Body Pile and Rusted Lockbox.
Teroclaw Hood is a world drop and is looted from Rusted Lockbox.
Teroclaw Jerkin is a world drop and is looted from Rusted Lockbox.
Teroclaw Shoulders are a world drop and are looted from Rusted Lockbox.
Teroclaw Waistband is a world drop and is looted from Rusted Lockbox.
Tempted Scholars are kyrian encountered by adventure companions in Bastion.
Terrace of Formation Report is provided by the Knight of the Ebon Blade on the northern border of the Great Veldt in Zereth Mortis.
Tensile Driveshafts could be used to create a Bundle of Recyclable Parts.
Temporal Leaf Seeds are sold by Seed Merchant Daybreak in Queen's Conservatory for .
Temporal Enigmatic Footguards are a quest reward from Favor of the First Ones.
Temporal Numerus Handguards are a quest reward from Favor of the First Ones.
Temporal Cryptic Grips are a quest reward from Favor of the First Ones.
Temporal Leaves Catalysts are plants planted with Temporal Leaves in Anima Catalyst Plots in the Queen's Conservatory.
Tender Xina is a green dragonspawn located in the Emerald Enclave in Valdrakken.
The Temporal Spyglass is looted from Lookout Mordren at South Hold Gate in Thaldraszus.
Tempting Fate: Fate of the Shadowlands is a world quest that is available at a Fated Raid.
Terrace Stagbeetles are beetles located at the Gardens og Unity in Thaldraszus.
Temporal Parmesan is sold by Gorgonzormu at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken for .
Tenezeth is a dead dracthyr found in the Support Creche in the Forbidden Reach.
Temporal Collectors are found in the Flowing Forest of Thaldraszus. Siaszerathel is looking for them in Time is Running Out.
Temporal Residue drop from all Time-Lost mobs in the Shifting Sands of Thaldraszus. Andantenormu is looking for them for Times Like These.
Termac the Terror is a tauren rogue sneaking around the Skyway in Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Terillod the Devout is a night elf located in the Waking Shores.
Tenith is a green drakonid located in the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken during Chaos and Commotion. He was among the inhabitants when the dragonkin rebels tried to detonate the seat.

Temporal Infused Rock Snails are rock snails located at Glitterspore Lake in Zaralek Cavern.
Temporal Defenders are located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus. They are often found accompanying Temporal Investigators.
Temporally Touched Argali are argali located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Temporally-Touched Butterflies are buttterfliess located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Tempo Smasher is contained in Tribute of the Enlightened Elders and Torn Ethereal Drape.

Terestian's Stranglestaff is an epic staff for feral druid damage dealers. Its top appears as a quadropus (four-tentacled octopus).
Rahauro sends the player to Ragefire Chasm under Orgrimmar to kill a couple of troggs. This quest is loosely related to the Lost Satchel mini quest chain.

.]] Thalassian is the primary language of blood elves, high elves, and void elves. It has both written and spoken equivalents. Individuals who are unfamiliar with the language's proper name may refer to it as High Elven. Like Nazja and Shalassian, Thalassian is derived from the Darnassian language. Hence, Thalassian is closely related to Darnassian and there is some overlap between the two languages. Further Darnassian utterances may, therefore, have been preserved in modern Thalassian, in addition to those that are specified below. So far, linguistic scholars have opted to err on the side of caution in documenting Darnassian terms and phrases that are also considered part of the Thalassian

Terrordale is a small town nestled in the northwest corner of Eastern Plaguelands. Because it lies on the edge of the Plaguewood, the area is a ghost town, inhabited only by Scourge and plagued animals. Just east of Terrordale lies the Argent Crusade-controlled Plaguewood Tower, and just north lies an entrance to the crypt fiend-infested Terrorweb Tunnel, which leads to the banks of the Thondroril River. It was previously haunted by Terrordale Spirits, with green auras permeating the ground as the physical world buckled under the torment of the spirit realm. Paladins eventually exorcised the tormenting spirits out of the area.
__NOTOC__ Thalgus Thunderfist is a dwarf weapon vendor located at Timberline Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Thaddius is the fourth and final boss of the Construct Quarter in Naxxramas. Thaddius appears in World of Warcraft as well as World of Warcraft: Ashbringer.

The Thalassian Base Camp was located in northern Azshara, south of the Legash Encampment and east of Ursolan. It was a hill containing numerous small camps under control of blood elves. The leader of the Thalassian Base Camp, Magus Rimtori, recently made and reneged on a deal with the Horde to offer a share of the findings in exchange for funding and protection of the expedition. Because of this betrayal, Horde players were being recruited to exact vengeance upon Magus Rimtori and her followers, during the quests Betrayed (2) and Betrayed (3). While Rimtori was off exploring Azshara under the protection of her bodyguards, Magister Hawkhelm watched over the camp. The Kaldorei Tome of Summonin

__NOTOC__ The Terrowulf Packlord is a rare worgen found in the Howling Vale of Ashenvale. He is on a 21-32 hour respawn timer. As of Cataclysm, the Terrowulf Packlord now is the last remaining worgen of the Terrowulf pack that holds their name. He can be found on his hands and knees in the Vale on a ledge, Looking almost dazed. It is likely due to the vale having been overrun by crazed ancients.

To celebrate the launch of the Honor System, Blizzard issued a Test of Honor Contest. This took place in both WoW USA and Europe from April 25 to May 24, 2005. They gave away top-of-line NVIDIA® 6800 series graphics cards and other prizes to lucky participants that took part in player-versus-player combat; however these prizes were only applicable for the USA contestants.
Terrorspark is a rare flamekin found in the Burning Steppes. He appears in a random lava flow to the northern side of the zone.

Terran is a language spoken by earth elementals hailing from Deephome. It is also known by conglomerates with the sub-type of earth. It is perhaps a dialect of Kalimag. The term "Terran" shows up in the Kalimag phrase, "Ter'ran" in the Kalimag language parser.

.]] Terramok (also called the Crystal Caverns or Crystal Caves of Terramok) is Princess Theradras' secret sanctuary located deep within Maraudon in Desolace. It is an ancient place with much history and contains relics of the Old Gods. After the death of her lover Zaetar, Theradras sequestered his body in Terramok. Based on this description, Terramok consists of at least the area around Zaetar's Grave and possibly all of the Earth Song Falls. Celebras the Redeemed, at the nearby Poison Falls, mentions that Theradras guards Zaetar's body "here in the crystal caverns", implying that the Poison Falls are also part of Terramok.

Tethis is a level 43 named male raptor found just north of the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe in Stranglethorn Vale. Hemet Nesingwary Jr. wants Tethis' talon. It is said that he survives solely on a diet of blueberries and Nesingwary hunters.

Test of Faith is a Horde quest in the Thousand Needles in which players test their faith. It is the first quest in the Test of Faith quest chain, which is a chain of quests involving "testing" some part of the player character's being.

Test of Endurance is a Horde quest in Thousand Needles in which players test their endurance. It is the second quest in the Test of Faith quest chain, which is a chain of quest involving "testing" some part of the player character's being. The first quest is Test of Faith (quest), which begins in The Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles, from Dorn Plainstalker.
The Testament of Hope is a quest reward from The Restless Souls (2).
__NOTOC__ Thaladred the Darkener is one of the four blood elf advisors that aid Kael'thas during the boss encounter in the Eye. He appears to be a Warrior.
Thadell is a human ghost quest giver located at the Town Square outside the Violet Tower in the Netherstorm.
Thalassian Wildercloak is an epic cloak for rogues and hunters.
Terrorcloth Mantle is a quest reward from Pursuing Terrorclaw and The Terror of Marshlight Lake.

Test of Faith is a Horde quest chain which begins in Thousand Needles but will take players around the world, eventually even bringing them to the Scarlet Monastery library. This quest chain also serves to introduce newer players to the lore behind the World of Warcraft story: The player must collect two books and be prepared to answer questions about them in order to complete the chain. The first book is about the Dragon Aspects, and the second is about the origins of the Scourge. The full text of the two books can be found: *Legacy of the Aspects *Beginnings of the Undead Threat

Terrordale Spirits could be found in the Eastern Plaguelands and were an objective of Exorcising Terrordale. They first had to be summoned by using an Exorcism Censer. Killing a Terrordale Spirit resulted in +5 reputation with the Argent Dawn.

Terrorclaw is a monstrous Bogstrok lobstrok in Marshlight Lake in Zangarmarsh. Certain slavemasters belonging to the Bloodscale naga in Bloodscale Enclave on the eastern shore of the lake have taken up the gruesome practice of feeding insubordinate slaves to Terrorclaw as punishment.
Terrordar the Tormentor was a level 70 elite eredar and presumably the leader of the Burning Legion forces in Forge Camp: Terror. He was removed with the addition of Ogri'la in patch 2.1.0.
__NOTOC__ Terrorfiends are terrorguards of the Burning Legion found at the Pools of Aggonar in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Thalia Amberhide is a tauren found under Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. She is a close friend of Lakota Windsong, the tauren who was kidnapped by Arnak Grimtotem. Before the Cataclysm, she was found residing in the inn of Freewind Post.
Tethyr is a level 40 elite kraken who is part of the Take Down Tethyr! questline.
Thalassian Ranger Gauntlets are epic mail gloves for hunters and enhancement shamans.
Territorial Trespass is part of the Sons of Hodir quest chain.
Terrorshaft Arrows are sold by General Goods vendors in Northrend for a stack.
__NOTOC__ Terror Spinner is a rare bone spider found in Zul'Drak.
Tewah Chillmane is a taunka leather armor vendor located at Taunka'le Village in the Borean Tundra.
Terror of Terokkar is a quest achievement earned by completing Terokkar Forest quests.

The Terrowulf were a pack of worgen, left behind in the Howling Vale of Ashenvale by Velinde Starsong. After the Cataclysm, the Terrowulf seems to either have left or been wiped out. The Terrowulf Packlord seems to be the last remaining worgen of the pack.
Territorial Dominance is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning 10 Arathi Basin battles while controlling all 5 flags.
Terrowulf Fleshrippers were worgen found near the Howling Vale shrine in Ashenvale.
Terrowulf Shadow Weavers were worgen found near the Howling Vale shrine in Ashenvale.
Thalorien Dawnseeker's Remains can be found at the entrance to the Dead Scar of the Isle of Quel'Danas for players on The Return of Quel'Delar quest chain.
__NOTOC__ Thalgran Blightbringer is a vargul found in the Lost Lands in Sholazar Basin.

Terrorblade Battlegear set is the Tier 8 rogue raid set. It is composed of any items from these sub-sets: *Valorous Terrorblade Battlegear - from armor tokens gained in 10-man Ulduar raids *Conqueror's Terrorblade Battlegear - from armor tokens gained in 25-man Ulduar raids
Terrapin Oils can be extracted from dead Seabrush Terrapins in Seabrush in Abyssal Depths with Oil Extrusion Pump.
__NOTOC__ Terrortooth Scytheclaws are raptors found in the Southern Barrens.
__NOTOC__ Terrortooth Runners are raptors found in the Southern Barrens.
Terrortooth Hides drop from Terrortooth Runners and Terrortooth Scytheclaws in the Southern Barrens.
Terrortooth Hide Bracers are a quest reward from Raptor Scraps.
Terrath's Signet of Balance is a reputation reward; you must be with Therazane to buy it from for .
The Territorial Helm is a quest reward from Foxes and Hounds.
Terrance Matterly was a human Isle of Conquest battlemaster located on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus during the Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest.
The Terror Wing Fossil Field is a Fossil dig site in Burning Steppes.

Terrath the Steady is an elite NPC found in Deepholm. Like the other Earth Lords he is at first reluctant to trust the player but through completing his quests and those of the other Earth Lords, as well as Therazane, you earn their trust and they come to your aid in the battle against the Twilight Hammer. He has shown desire to bring the Stone Drakes under the service of Therazane. When the shaman adventurer arrives at the Stonemother's throne, the Stonemother herself was in conversation with Terrath thinking that he was overreacting on something for that answers will come.

Terrorpene is an enormous turtle that lives in the fire near Sulfuron Spire. He is known for being the only lavatortise to be tamed by hunters. Interestingly, the smoke that spouts from volcano on his nose is quite an attraction for those who wish to catch him. He has the same model as Volcanoth and Nemesis.
Handler Tessina has three different whistles for use during her "Forces of Nature" quests: *Tessina's Wisp Call *Tessina's Hippogryph Call *Tessina's Treant Call
Tessina's Wisp Call is provided as an objective for Forces of Nature: Wisps.
Tessina's Treant Call is provided as an objective for Forces of Nature: Treants.
Tessina's Hippogryph Call is provided as an objective for Forces of Nature: Hippogryphs.
Tex Vortacoil is a goblin reagent vendor located in Azshara. Apart from his regular reagents he also sells Kalytha's Haunted Locket.
Thalnos the Soulrender is the first boss of Scarlet Monastery.

Terrocotta Warriors are terracotta warriors found in Mogujia within the Kun-Lai Summit. They have been animated through some unknown means, though Mogujia Soul-Caller is hinted to have been behind their reanimation.
Terracotta Gladiators are terracotta warriors located in the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit.
Thagg is an orc quest giver in Ashenvale. He leads the Horde forces attempting to conquer Raynewood Retreat.
__NOTOC__ If you plant an Ominous Seed at Sunsong Ranch it can grow into the Terrible Turnip. Ominous Seeds are rarely acquired when harvesting fully-grown vegetables.
Terromath the Seared is a Blackrock clan orc found at the Valley of Ashes in the Burning Steppes.
Terrific Trio is a Character achievement earned when the player reaches maximum level on three characters with different classes.
Terrance Storm is a human quest giver located at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands. He placed all his army concentrating on the dragons to the north that he forgot the ogres to the south.
The Terracotta Heads can be found at multiple locations within Mogujia, Kun-Lai Summit and is one of the treasures of Pandaria. Its location changes whenever a player picks it up.
Terror Spawns are elite sha mobs found in the Terrace of Endless Spring. They are adds in the Sha of Fear encounter and do not move from their spawn point.
Test Pilot Britches are a quest reward from The Short Way Home.
Teve Dawnchaser is a tauren stable master found at Thunder Cleft in Krasarang Wilds. He is a member of the Dawnchaser tribe, which traveled to Pandaria in search of a dreamed paradise.
Terrapis is a rare turtle that can be found at the southern border of Elwynn Forest. It walks back and forth along the riverbank, from Jerod's Landing to the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.

Terrence Fallrook is the father of Cedrick and Erik and an owner of Fallrook Estate and its winery. He is described as a good and important man in Southshore and might have been a part in a tribunal of Erik's murder. Kerri Hicks was the only suspect. Later, Peter Hamelspot, who worked for the Fallrooks for almost 30 years witnessed Erik's death by the hand of Cedrick. However, Terrence told Marshal Redpath that Cedrick was with him that night. After they returned home, he revealed that he believed Peter. He tossed Cedrick some money and told him to leave. It is unknown what became with him after the Forsaken invasion to Hillsbrad.
Test Drive is a quest achievement earned for growing a Kunchong to full size and take it on a rampage.
__NOTOC__ Terrorguard Chestplate drops from Malkorok in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Thaelin's Quick Fix is provided as an objective for Thaelin's Quick Fix (quest).

Terran Justice Gregory is the Lead Cinematic Narrative Designer for World of Warcraft. Gregory joined Blizzard in June 2006, and works almost exclusively on World of Warcraft. Other projects include writing and directing the Chromie hero trailer for Heroes of the Storm, and reference work for the 2016 film Warcraft. Gregory has worked on Antorus, the Burning Throne's ending cinematic, as well as World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth's CGI cinematic and announcement.

Teya Dawnchaser is a tauren found at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds. She is a member of the Dawnchaser tribe, which traveled to Pandaria in search of a dreamed paradise. She and some others were sent to scout the region by Dezco.
Terrorbane is a yaungol located at the Yaungol Advance in Kun-Lai Summit.

Terrie Denman is Senior VFX Artist on World of Warcraft. Her responsibilities are designing visual effects kits for existing and new player classes, environment effects, and effects for boss encounters. She works cross discipline regularly to make optimized real-time visual effects. She notably made the Violet Spellwing mount.
Thaelrid's Greaves are a quest reward from The Rise of Aku'mai.

Test Bot 024B is a crowd pummeler located outside Elodor in .
Tesslah's Ticking Treads are a world drop from Pandaria mobs.
Thaesus is a draenei blacksmithing supplies vendor located inside the Lion's Den at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.

Terrorfist is a gronnling that is occasionally seen heading toward the Rangari Refuge in Tanaan Jungle. When it spawns, it will be marked on the world map with and a zone-wide announcement will be broadcasted: *

Thal'goroth is an annihilan that appears at the Legion Invasion locations during Stage 3.

Thaelin's Notebook contains the working notes and secrets of engineer Thaelin Darkanvil from the last five years. Within are manufacturing techniques, schematics for new inventions and a quantity of embarrassing doodles.

Thal'kiel's Ascendance is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Jaws of Shadow and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.

Thalanir Dawnrise is a sin'dorei scholar who studied demons, including infernals and the nathrezim.
Thaddeus "Gramps" Rifthold is a human located at North Pass Caverns in Drustvar.

Tevs Rusthammer is a goblin located on board the Horde gunship in the Seething Shore.

King Tezlekhan the Virulent was a king of the Zandalari Empire and the great-grandfather of King Rastakhan. He once tried to get the tortollans to leave Zandalar, but because tortollans live longer than trolls do, they were able to get political dirt on the royal family and convince Tezlekhan to let them stay. The tortollans remember him as someone who was "[a] bit full of himself".
Terrified Suramar Children are nightborne located in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Terrified Lunastre Nobles are nightborne located in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Terrified Lunastre Attendants are nightborne located in Suramar.
Terrorfin can be fished from Val'sharah in open water while under the effect of the Nightmare Nightcrawler.

Tezran is an ethereal located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He is a Master of Fate, and will soon be able to provide players with a Seal of Wartorn Fate in exchange for Gold, War Resources or Marks of Honor. He resides in the same shop as transmogrifier Warpweaver Ezil and Azerite Reforger Razzi the Shaper.
Terrified Squirrels are squirrels fleeing in terror from the fires burning Mount Hyjal.
The Testament of the Valorous is sent in the mailbox upon obtaining the achievement The Chosen.
Terrorvine Lashers are lashers located in Ash'theran in Val'sharah.

Tevan Whitfield was a rather handsome Forsaken blacksmith who once needed the help of Vellcinda Benton with replacing his injured hand. He admitted to her that he questioned the Forsaken's reason to be. This prompted Vellcinda to think about it too and discuss the matter with others, eventually establishing the Desolate Council as a government body in the absence of Queen Sylvanas and as a response to the strict Forsaken culture. He died during the third invasion of the Burning Legion when he faced his greatest fear and lost the gamble. Vellcinda remembered him during a memorial ceremony.
Teshunji is a Zandalari troll located in Dazar'alor. He is sitting with Ban'zal, Junanji, and Judyna. He was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.

Tesinjo is a Zandalari troll located inside the Temple of Akunda in Vol'dun. He is initially known as Akunda the Hallowed and is one of the trolls responsible for keeping Akunda incapacitated, but he resumes his true name and kneels down next to the freed loa after completion of Ending the Madness.
The Territorial Hydra is a mandragora located among the cliffs on the Cracked Coast in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Terrifying Abominations are abominations located in Acherus in the Scarlet Enclave.
Test Subject #362 is a leper gnome clone who works for . He is the minion of Zerek and helps him with his cloning experiment.
Terrified Nethergarde Miners are humans located in the Nethergarde Armory in the Blasted Lands.
The Test Insignia was in the patch 7.2.0 Public Test Realm testing the reputation granting function.
__NOTOC__ Territorial Razorwings are wind serpents located in the Slough in Zuldazar.

Thalassian Priests are high elves located at the Dead Scar of Ghostlands during The First to Fall. They also appear at the Dead Scar near the East Sanctum of Eversong Woods during The Day Hope Died. Ultimately, they appear in the Sunwell during The Fall of the Sunwell.
Thalassian Civilians are high elves located at the Dead Scar near the East Sanctum of Eversong Woods during The Day Hope Died.
Thalassian Magisters are high elves located in the Sunwell Plateau during The Fall of the Sunwell.
